stocks.name: 北川鉄工所
stocks.businessSummary: Kitagawa Corporation manufactures and supplies synthetic metals, machine tool accessories, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers standard and advanced chucks, jaw force testers, manual chucks, rotary cylinders, chuck parts, NC rotary tables, power vises, work grippers, robot accessories, vise parts, and other peripheral equipment for machine tools such as turning centres and vertical machining centres. It also provides tower cranes for building construction, concrete mixing plants, multi-story car parking, and bridge erection machines, as well as recycling plants; and components for automotive industry. The company was formerly known as Kitagawa Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Corporation in June 2018. Kitagawa Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

stocks.name: ミズホメディー
stocks.businessSummary: Mizuho Medy Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of in vitro diagnostic products, and related scientific and technical information services in Japan. The company offers molecular diagnostic products, such as nucleic acid amplification test products comprising gene analysis instruments and mycoplasma pneumoniae nucleic acid kits. It also provides rapid immunoassay products, including influenza virus antigen test kit; RS virus and human metapneumovirus antigen test kit; streptococcus pneumoniae antigen and legionella antigen test kit; mycoplasma pneumoniae antigen test kit; adenovirus antigen test kit; rotavirus and adenovirus antigen test kit ;norovirus antigen test kit; Group A streptococcal antigen test kit; pregnancy test kit; ovulation test kit; and fecal occult blood test kit for in vitro diagnostic use. In addition, it offers reagents for detection in research and agriculture use; and reagents for biochemical test. Further, the company engages in import and export activities. It operates in the United States, Belgium, Finland, Netherlands, Taiwan, Thailand, and internationally. Mizuho Medy Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Tosu, Japan.

stocks.name: ＰＥＧＡＳＵＳ
stocks.businessSummary: Pegasus Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial sewing machines in Japan, China, Bangladesh, India, rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Apparel Machinery Business and Automotive Business segments. The company offers overlock and safety stitch, interlock and double chain stitch, automatic and labor-saving unit, and non-apparel industrial sewing machines. It also produces and sells automotive parts comprising seat belt, antenna, lamp, harness, auto door, door mirror, auxiliary lamp, headlight, wiper, and display parts. The company was formerly known as Pegasus Sewing Machine Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Pegasus Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Pegasus Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

stocks.name: 日本精鉱
stocks.businessSummary: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells antimony products and metal powders in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It offers antimony trioxide, which is used as a flame-retardant additive for various plastic material and polyester polymerization catalysts. The company also provides antimony metal for use in raw materials for semiconductors, film for optical memory disk, or thermo-electron converter, as well as for storage batteries, bearing metals, hard lead castings, cables sheathing, type metals, and sheet and pipe alloys; antimony metal powder for glass fining agents and alloys; and antimony metal shots for alloys. In addition, it offers special treatment antimony trioxide; sodium antimonate for use in engineering plastics, and defoaming agent and decolorizing agent for high-grade glass, such as optical glass; antimony trisulfide for use in friction material in brake pads and brake shoes; and antimony pentasulfide used for surface treatment of decorative trims and building materials. Further, the company provides antimony trichloride and antimony pentachloride for use as catalysts in fluorination, chlorination, and bromination of organic compounds, pigments, and semiconductor materials; tin sulfides used as a solid lubricant; SULMICS-121, a black powder composed of tin sulfides and graphite, which is used as a solid lubricant in automotive brake pads and related applications; and STEM series for poly-olefin plastics, such as PP and PE. Additionally, it offers metal powder products, including copper, soft magnetic alloy, copper alloy metal, and silver powder that are used as parts materials in various fields comprising automobiles, information equipment, industrial equipment, and electrical appliances. The company was formerly known as Nakase Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. in 1936. Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

stocks.name: 新家工業
stocks.businessSummary: Araya Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Steel Pipe-Related Business, Bicycle-Related Business, and Real Estate Leasing Business. The company offers ordinary steel pipes, stainless steel pipes, deformed steel pipes, various shaped steel pipes, and precision parts for OA machines. It also offers wheelchair suspension wheels, wing arms, wheelchair with absolex, and industrial absolex, as well as bicycle rims; and imports and sells bicycles. In addition, the company engages in real estate rental business, including leasing of lands, buildings, and warehouses. Further, it offers welfare equipment. Araya Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1903 and is based in Osaka, Japan.
